note: ElevenLabs server tools (webhooks) for the HarvestNet voice line, ticket #4. PLACEHOLDER endpoints: replace API_BASE_URL with the real API address, and the paths with the voice-intake paths agreed in ticket #1 (contract day). Field names are proposed and match Lane B's front-desk assistant (#14), which expects a transcript of language plus speaker turns.

tools.name: prepare_request
tools.description: Send the household's answers so HarvestNet can read them back. Nothing is saved yet. Call this after asking all the questions, and again after any correction.

conversation_id.description: The ElevenLabs conversation id, so the API can match later calls in the same call.

language.description: The language the call is in: en for English, es for Spanish.

turns.description: Each question you asked and the household's answer, in order, using the household's exact words.

example_response.speak: You told me: 4 people, weekdays after 6 pm, limited fridge space, near Watsonville, nothing you can't eat, and you receive CalFresh.
example_response.consent_question: May HarvestNet keep these answers for 7 days to find produce for your household? We don't keep your name or address.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Save the request after the household clearly said yes to the consent question. Never call this without a clear yes.

consent.description: Only yes. If the household says no, don't call this tool.

example_response.speak: Your household's fresh produce share is 12 pounds a week. Food banks near you with evening pickup: the rural food bank, Monday to Friday, 4 to 8 pm, and the city food bank, Monday to Saturday, 3 to 8 pm. Which can you get to?

tools.name: choose_food_banks
tools.description: Record which food banks the household can get to. They may choose more than one.

food_bank_ids.description: The ids of the food banks the household chose, from the submit_request response.

example_response.speak: You're on the list for the rural food bank and the city food bank. When produce is ready, the food bank will have it for you with your code.
